title: Galway's Land National Park
displaytitle: Galway's Land National Park

titles.display: Galway's Land National Park

extract: Galways Land National Park is a small 27 ha (0.10 mi2) national park consisting of dense montane forest. It is located within the city limits of Nuwara Eliya in Sri Lanka, approximately 2 km (1 mi) east of the city centre. The area was first declared a wildlife sanctuary on 27 May 1938, and later upgraded to national park status on 18 May 2006. The park was established to conserve the unique montane ecosystems of the region.
